era: Super Nintendo / Nintendo 64 / Nintendo 3DS / Nintendo Classics
summary: Nintendo's arcade flight-sim series; use Nintendo Classics for the SNES and N64 games, and original 3DS hardware for Pilotwings Resort.

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Classics SNES app / local SNES emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use official Nintendo Classics route first.

primary.why: The SNES original has been re-released across Virtual Console and Nintendo Classics services; Nintendo Switch Online is the current official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Nintendo Switch Online's Super NES app; use original SNES hardware or local SNES emulation only for comparison.

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Classics N64 app / local N64 emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use official Nintendo Classics route first.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official Nintendo Classics emulation or high-resolution local N64 emulation

primary.why: Pilotwings 64 was an N64 launch title and received its first official re-release on Nintendo Classics in 2022, making that the best official modern route.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack's Nintendo 64 app; use original N64 hardware or local N64 emulation only for comparison.

emulation.emulator: Nintendo 3DS hardware / Citra-derived preservation where available
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original 3DS stereoscopic display or high-resolution 3DS emulation

primary.why: Pilotwings Resort is a 3DS-only sequel built for stereoscopic 3D and Wuhu Island free-flight/mission play; no modern port is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Nintendo 3DS hardware for the intended stereoscopic 3D presentation; use the downloadable version only if already owned.
